notes.title: Version 2.0.1
notes.content:
[b]THIS IS A BIG UPDATE FOR THE GAME![/b]

[b]UPDATES INCLUDE:[/b]
[list]
[*]Pause menu during gameplay -
[*]Fixed bugs and issues with the score -
[*]Full controller support -
[*]Added a new map called Striped -
[*]Added a new map called Blackout -
[*]Added a customizable difficulty -
[*]Added German as a interface language -
[*]Added Spanish as a interface language -
[*]Added Portuguese as a interface language -
[*]Added Russian as a interface language -
[*]Added Japanese as a interface language -
[*]Added Chinese as a interface language -
[/list]

[b] HAVE FUN! [/b]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Released!
notes.content:
[b]CHANGE LOG[/b]
[list]
[*]Bugs/Issues Fixes- 
[*]Added Directories for songs so you can choose any folder on your computer to hold your songs -
[*]Widened walljump opening width -
[*]Ajusted the distance between obstacles on "Insane" -
[*]Tutorial now waits for a little no matter what so you can read the info
[/list]
